assembly.why: observed: 18 pad-bearing part(s) on F and 0 on B, 1 reflow pass(es). every footprint BLOCK (#726): blocks sharing one reference are keyed with an ordinal suffix and counted separately. `pad_bearing` restricts that to blocks carrying at least one pad, and it is the count the populated-side verdict is taken from -- a zero-pad graphic on the back does not make a board double-sided.

blocks.name: xtal-loop
blocks.note: 12MHz loop on U1 pins 9/10, which at U1 rot90 sit at the NORTH end of its east pad row (134.62, 95.08/95.73). This is the free band between U1's north copper (94.91) and the north edge; it keeps the loop under ~3mm and leaves the U1<->USB1 gap free as the board's only north-south corridor.

blocks.name: serial-series-r
blocks.note: R3/R4 terminate U1 pins 3/4 (east row, south end at y 99.63/98.98) and carry /U0RXD and /U0TXD onward to the connectors. This pocket is south of the D+/D- lane (y 98.25-98.90) and west of USB1's copper (139.73), so the pair is not boxed in.

blocks.name: vbus-regulator
blocks.note: VBUS -> C1 -> U2 -> /+3.3V is the only loop that must stay compact and carry current; its three anchors are USB1 pin1 (140.70, 99.64), CON2 pin7 (132.12, 104.30) and U2 itself. This is the free south-east pocket east of CON2 and south of USB1's copper.

blocks.name: u1-decoupling
blocks.note: C3 is U1's /+3.3V decoupling; U1's +3.3V pin 19 is on its WEST row at (127.38, 100.28), so the cap belongs immediately west/south-west of U1 rather than beside the regulator.

blocks.name: auto-reset
blocks.note: /DTR and /RTS leave U1's WEST row (pins 15/16 at (127.38, 97.68/98.33)); Q1+R1 and Q2+R2 are the two cross-coupled legs and their /DCOM and /EN outputs run on to CON1 (west edge) and CON2 (south). This is the west corridor, the largest free area left once the three connectors are seated.

blocks.name: fiducial-nw
blocks.note: Ref* is a netless 1x1 fiducial and is movable residue: USB1's declared east seat covers its carried pose. A fiducial wants a clear corner on the populated side, and the north-west corner is the only one not claimed by USB1 (east), CON2 (south) or CON1 (west-centre). Ref[*] is an fnmatch literal so this block cannot capture the locked Ref*~2.
